# Following links

A fixture for following a link to another Markdown file in the pager. Tab
selects a link, Enter follows it and Backspace comes back to this place.

![The icon of the start document](../images/icon.png)

This paragraph is here to give the window something to scroll. A link to
[the second heading of the other document](docs/other.md#second) opens
`docs/other.md` over this one, with that heading on the top line, and the
status line names the file.

A link to [a file that is not there](docs/missing.md) says why it cannot be
opened and opens nothing.

## Filler

The filler keeps the links above the end of the document, so that Backspace
has a place to come back to.
